snippet.title: Scary Tales Vol 1 - Retro Horror Anthology
snippet.description:
SCARY TALES - You wake up to a strange package at your door. 4 mysterious  tapes you don't remember ordering. Will you dare to watch them?

Updated with a new Silent Hill 4 / Creepshow inspired segment to tie it all together

Grab it before Halloween: https://puppetcombo.itch.io/scary-tales-vol-1
